# Steve Campbell Associates

> Chartered building consultancy and specialist construction and property dispute resolution practice led by Steve Campbell DipAdj FCIArb FFPWS MCIOB. Arbitration (domestic and international), construction adjudication, party wall surveying and third surveyor appointments, mediation, expert determination, early neutral evaluation, expert witness services and construction claims consultancy. Based in Berkhamsted, Hertfordshire, England; serves clients across England and Wales and internationally, including Portugal.

Key facts:
- Principal: Steve Campbell — Chartered Construction Manager, international arbitrator, construction adjudicator, mediator, expert witness and party wall surveyor.
- More than 40 years in the construction industry: trades, site management, project management, construction director. Projects managed from about £10,000 to more than £80 million under JCT, NEC, FIDIC and bespoke contracts.
- Working in dispute resolution since 2009; has appeared in the county court, the Technology and Construction Court, and in arbitrations, adjudications and mediations. Regularly selected as a third surveyor under the Party Wall etc. Act 1996.
- Qualifications and memberships: DipAdj; Fellow, Chartered Institute of Arbitrators (FCIArb); Fellow, Faculty of Party Wall Surveyors (FFPWS); Member, Chartered Institute of Building (MCIOB); Founding Fellow, Party Wall Academy; Member, Society of Construction Law; Member, Adjudication Society; Member, Pyramus and Thisbe Society.
- Acts either as an independent appointee (adjudicator, arbitrator, mediator, expert determiner, third surveyor) or as adviser/representative for one party — never both on the same matter.
- Clients: main contractors, subcontractors, house builders, developers, property owners, building and adjoining owners, architects, engineers, surveyors, solicitors, barristers and insurers.
- Free, confidential initial consultation.
- Contact: +44 7766 103543 · steve@stevecampbellassociates.com · 3 Claridge Court, Lower Kings Road, Berkhamsted, Hertfordshire HP4 2AE, United Kingdom.
- Not a firm of solicitors; does not advise on Portuguese law (works alongside clients' Portuguese lawyers).

## Services
- [Construction Adjudication](https://stevecampbellassociates.com/services/adjudication/): Statutory adjudication under the Construction Act: payment disputes, smash and grab and true value claims, variations, delay and final accounts.
- [Arbitration](https://stevecampbellassociates.com/services/arbitration/): Domestic and international construction and property arbitration, with Steve acting as arbitrator or as party representative.
- [Party Wall Surveying](https://stevecampbellassociates.com/services/party-wall-surveyor/): Building owner's, adjoining owner's, agreed and third surveyor appointments under the Party Wall etc. Act 1996.
- [Mediation](https://stevecampbellassociates.com/services/mediation/): Confidential, facilitated negotiation for construction, commercial and property disputes, before or during proceedings.
- [Expert Determination & ENE](https://stevecampbellassociates.com/services/expert-determination-and-early-neutral-evaluation/): Fast, binding expert decisions on defined technical questions, and non-binding early evaluations of the merits.
- [Expert Witness](https://stevecampbellassociates.com/services/expert-witness/): Independent construction expert evidence for the courts, arbitration and adjudication, prepared under CPR Part 35.
- [Construction Claims & Consultancy](https://stevecampbellassociates.com/services/construction-consultancy/): Claims preparation, extensions of time, delay analysis, loss and expense, contract advice and project management.
- [Projects in Portugal](https://stevecampbellassociates.com/portugal/): International arbitration, mediation, construction expert reports and contract advice for projects in Portugal and for Portugal-based clients with UK matters.
